identity.title: [v0.92][C-SDLC v2][defect] Keep deferred-validator admission consistent across ready transition

values.summary: Bootstrap and freshly review a child-specific design, then after separate authorization approve, doctor, bind, implement the narrow pre-bind readiness correction and actual-sequence regression, validate, and obtain exact-head review.

steps.action: Bootstrap #349 in a clean current-main preparation root and obtain fresh design review.
After approval and bind, preserve #79 predicates while making ready admission coherent.
Add and run the actual advertised-sequence regression plus existing negative matrix.
Run formatting, strict Clippy, and fresh exact-head review before publication.

invariants: Deferred admission is limited to initialized and ready pre-bind phases
All existing #79 exact-path and fail-closed predicates remain intact
Bound and later execution phases require materialized proof targets
Only the eventual bound #349 worktree receives source edits
risks: Allowing ready deferral too broadly could weaken execution readiness
Doctor guidance could remain misleading if ready state semantics are not asserted
A narrow regression could miss negative #79 mutation cases
stop_conditions: Any need to admit deferrals after bound
Any weakened exact-path, defer-reason, proving-lane, or failure-policy predicate
Any scope expansion into unrelated lifecycle transitions
Fresh review reports an actionable finding
